game_title: Loop Choreography – Fairy Ring Glade Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round, bog toads strike the fairy lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sync value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fairy lantern from bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade: keep the sync meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: sync drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
